name: Side-Kick Drill
description: Kick a full length on your side: bottom arm extended forward, top arm resting on the hip, eyes down at the bottom of the pool with the lower goggle submerged. Small steady kick from the hips. To breathe, roll slightly back toward the spine until the face clears, then roll down again. Alternate sides each length. Teaches body rotation, side balance, and breathing off the roll instead of turning the neck — and because the arms are parked, the legs cannot hide.
